meta.seoHeading: Affordable local services — cleaning, repairs, plumbing, electrical, moving and more. Compare quotes from trusted providers, hire with confidence, and pay securely. GruntWrk is the cheap, simple way to get work done without middleman fees.

nav.brandSub: Get work done. Find work fast.

hero.title: Free to join. Free to quote. Free to hire.

benefits.heading: Why customers pay less on GruntWrk
benefits.subtitle: When providers aren't charged to find work, they don't need to inflate their prices. That saving goes straight to you.

items.title: Affordable prices for you
items.desc: Service providers don't pay lead fees, credit packs, or subscriptions to be on GruntWrk. That means more affordable quotes for you.

items.title: Hire with confidence
items.desc: See every job a provider has completed, read what other customers said, and check their ratings before you hire.

items.title: Simple, secure payments
items.desc: Pay half upfront, half when the job is done. The platform handles everything. No cash, no transfers, no hassle.

fees.heading: Most others charge at every step.
fees.subtitle: Other platforms charge providers lead fees, credit packs, subscriptions, and visibility boosts. Providers recover those costs by charging customers more. GruntWrk only charges a platform payment fee, so providers keep more and customers pay less.
fees.note: Based on public pricing and help-center pages reviewed on March 16, 2026. Fees vary by service and market.

rows.marketSummary: Some marketplaces charge a one-time provider onboarding fee before you can start taking work.
Pay to unlock customer details or spend money each time you want to pursue a job.
Prepay for credits or contact packs before you can quote on requests.
Pay extra to appear higher in search or unlock more exposure for your profile.
Monthly platform access or plan fees just to stay listed and compete for work.
Charged when a customer shortlists you or shows a stronger signal of intent.
Extra payment-related charges layered on top of other marketplace fees.
A portion of provider funds can be retained on-platform before payout is released.
A single transaction fee when the booking and payment are completed through the platform.

howItWorks.heading: How GruntWrk works
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple flow from request to completion

steps.title: Describe what you need
steps.body: Post your request, location, and budget.

steps.title: Choose who to hire
steps.body: Receive quotes from matched providers or book directly with a provider of your choice.

steps.title: Manage the job in one place
steps.body: Use your workbench to message, confirm the provider, follow payment, and rebook trusted providers with confidence.

workbench.title: Compare, book, message, pay, and rebook.

points.title: Compare quotes clearly
points.desc: Providers compete on quality and price, not on who paid more for visibility. See your options side by side and pick the right fit.

points.title: Book directly when ready
points.desc: Already know who you want? Send a request straight to that provider. Check their ratings and previous jobs first.

points.title: Keep everything together
points.desc: Messages, progress, payment, and reviews live inside the job workbench. One place for the full history.

points.title: Pay and rebook with confidence
points.desc: Pay half upfront, half when the job is done. No cash, no transfers. The platform handles it all.

items.text: Very effective platform for connecting clients and service providers. Finding and booking a job is simple and fast.
The notice board feature is well organised and makes it easy to find available services in your area.
I like how profiles show ratings, skills, and reviews. It helps users quickly evaluate providers.
No lead fees, no credit packs. I just sign up and start quoting. More of what I earn stays with me.
